description: Luw.ai Magic Prompt AI: edit any image with a plain-language instruction: "make the sofa green velvet", "add a pendant lamp over the table", "turn it into a night scene". Pass products, materials or a mood board as reference_images to place or apply them. For edits restricted to an exact area, use luw_magic_wand. Costs 1 credit per variation.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

image.description: Image to edit (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

reference_images.description: Up to 6 reference images (furniture, materials, products, mood boards) to draw from.

items.description: Reference image (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

variations.description: Number of alternative designs (1-4, default 1); each is billed as a generation.

name: luw_edit_image
title: Edit image with a prompt (Magic Prompt AI)
